segments.speaker: Bob

segments.text: Honestly great, but the commute is brutal. I'm thinking of switching to remote two days a week.
segments.speaker: Alice

segments.text: You should pitch it to your manager. I'll send you that proposal template I used.
segments.speaker: Bob

segments.text: That'd help a lot. I'll draft something by Friday.
segments.speaker: Alice
